name: Stability Ball Wall Squat
steps: Pin a stability ball firmly between your lower-to-mid back and a smooth wall, then step your feet forward shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core, keep your chest tall, and lean lightly back into the ball for smooth support.
Bend your knees and hips together to roll smoothly down the wall until your thighs approach parallel to the floor.
Press evenly through both feet to roll back up to standing without snapping your knees straight.
tips: Place your feet far enough forward that your shins stay roughly vertical at the bottom of the squat.
Keep both knees tracking smoothly over your toes without collapsing inward.
